name: Nexo Music
summary:
Nexo Music is a music player designed for Meta Quest. Enjoy your music directly in VR with a simple, fast, and Quest-friendly interface.

🎵 Search and listen to your favorite tracks
🔎 Find music easily
🥽 Optimized for Meta Quest
⚡ Fast and smooth playback
🌐 Real-time service updates

Nexo Music — Your music, directly on your Quest.
